```{=typst}
// Sizes follow handoff/visual-reference/summary_refined.jsx: its page is
// 1056 x 816 px for 11 x 8.5 in (96 px/in), so 1 px = 0.75 pt.
#set text(font: "Poppins", size: 7pt, number-type: "lining", number-width: "tabular")
#set text(top-edge: "ascender", bottom-edge: "descender")  // CSS-like line boxes
#set par(justify: false)
#show table.cell: set block(breakable: false)

#let c-ink   = rgb("#16272D")
#let c-body  = rgb("#3C4A4F")
#let c-muted = rgb("#7A848A")
#let c-track = rgb("#E4ECEE")

// Tract name on one line (10.5 px): if wider than the cell, drop characters
// until the name plus an ellipsis fits. The full name is on the detail sheet.
#let oneline(s, w: 2.437in - 12pt) = context {
  let t(x) = text(size: 7.9pt, weight: "semibold", fill: c-ink, x)
  if measure(t(s)).width <= w { t(s) } else {
    let c = s.clusters()
    let n = c.len()
    while n > 1 and measure(t(c.slice(0, n).join() + "…")).width > w { n -= 1 }
    t(c.slice(0, n).join().trim() + "…")
  }
}

// In-cell measure: 12 px number (+ 8 px muted unit) over a 4 px bar.
// full: false sizes the bar to the number's width, as the design's key cells do.
#let kcell(num, unit, pct, color, full: false) = context {
  let line = [#text(size: 9pt, weight: "semibold", fill: c-ink)[#num]#if unit != "" [#h(1.5pt)#text(size: 6pt, fill: c-muted)[#unit]]]
  let w = if full { 100% } else { calc.max(measure(line).width, 16pt) }
  let fill = if pct == none { none } else {
    block(width: calc.min(calc.max(pct, 0), 100) * 1%, height: 3pt, fill: color, radius: 2.25pt)
  }
  stack(dir: ttb, spacing: 2.25pt, line,
    block(width: w, height: 3pt, fill: c-track, radius: 2.25pt, clip: true, fill))
}

// Two-line figure cell (9.5 px, line-height 1.32): "4,820 pop" / "1,910 hh"
#let pair(v1, u1, v2, u2) = {
  set par(leading: -0.05em)
  set text(size: 7.1pt, fill: c-body)
  [#text(weight: "semibold", fill: c-ink)[#v1] #u1#linebreak()#text(weight: "semibold", fill: c-ink)[#v2] #u2]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(yaml)

settings <- yaml::read_yaml("config/settings.yml")
report_data <- readRDS(file.path(params$data_dir, "report_data.rds"))

county_data <- dplyr::filter(report_data, county == params$county) |>
  dplyr::arrange(GEOID)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
teal       <- "#003B4F"
teal_mid   <- "#0E5C72"
teal_soft  <- "#3E7E91"
sky        <- "#7EC8E3"
amber      <- "#C77B30"
key_tint   <- "#F1F7F8"
row_stripe <- "#F7FAFB"
line_cool  <- "#CADDE2"
hair       <- "#EEF3F4"
ink        <- "#16272D"
body_c     <- "#3C4A4F"
muted_c    <- "#7A848A"
mono       <- '"IBM Plex Mono"'

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_val <- function(x, digits = 1, suffix = "", big_mark = "") {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("—")
  if (is.numeric(x) && !is.finite(x)) return("—")
  rounded <- round(x, digits)
  if (digits == 0 && nchar(big_mark) > 0) {
    return(paste0(format(as.integer(rounded), big.mark = big_mark, scientific = FALSE), suffix))
  }
  paste0(format(rounded, scientific = FALSE), suffix)
}

col_val <- function(data, col) {
  if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else NA_real_
}

oz_color <- function(cls) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("Likely to attract", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) &
      !grepl("More|Less|Un", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "#15705A",
    grepl("More likely", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "#2F8FB0",
    grepl("Less likely", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "#D98A3D",
    grepl("Unlikely|not likely", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "#B4532E",
    TRUE ~ "#9AA3A8"
  )
}

oz_class_short <- function(cls) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("Likely to attract", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) &
      !grepl("More|Less|Un", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Likely",
    grepl("More likely", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "More Likely",
    grepl("Less likely", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Less Likely",
    grepl("Unlikely|not likely", cls, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Unlikely",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

# Typst call for an in-cell measure. pct is the bar fill (0-100) or none.
# Built with paste0(), never sprintf(), because values can carry a literal %.
kcell <- function(num_str, pct, color, unit = "", full = FALSE) {
  has_unit <- num_str != "—" && nchar(unit) > 0
  pct_t    <- if (is.na(pct) || !is.finite(pct)) "none" else format(round(pct, 1), nsmall = 1)
  paste0('#kcell("', num_str, '", "', if (has_unit) unit else "", '", ', pct_t,
         ', rgb("', color, '")', if (full) ', full: true' else '', ')')
}

# Typst string literal: escape \ and "
typst_str <- function(x) gsub('"', '\\\\"', gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x))

# ── Column maxima for relative bar scaling ────────────────────────────────────
safe_max <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(v) || v == 0) NA_real_ else v
}
col_max <- list(
  oz1_pct = safe_max(county_data$oz1_pct),
  muc     = safe_max(county_data$wc_muc_pct),
  ato     = safe_max(county_data$ato_composite),
  sap     = safe_max(county_data$sap_planned_hh_per_acre),
  eru     = safe_max(county_data$eru_per_acre)
)
rel_pct <- function(val, mx) {
  if (is.na(val) || !is.finite(val) || is.na(mx)) NA_real_ else min(val / mx * 100, 100)
}

n_tracts    <- nrow(county_data)
county_name <- params$county

# ── Running page header: teal band (padding 11/16 px) + legend strip ──────────
hdr_block <- paste0(
  '#block(fill: rgb("', teal, '"), width: 100%, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 8.25pt), radius: 3.75pt, below: 0pt)[',
  '#grid(columns: (auto, 1fr, auto), column-gutter: 9.75pt, align: horizon,',
  # WFRC/MAG badge: mono 9 px, 1 px teal-soft border, radius 4 px, padding 5/8 px
  '[#rect(fill: none, stroke: 0.75pt + rgb("', teal_soft, '"), inset: (x: 6pt, y: 3.75pt), radius: 3pt)',
  '[#set par(leading: -0.25em);#align(center)[#text(font: ', mono, ', fill: rgb("', sky, '"), weight: "semibold", ',
  'size: 6.75pt, tracking: 0.75pt)[WFRC#linebreak()MAG]]]],',
  # Title 21 px bold, subtitle 10.5 px #CFE6EE, 3 px apart
  '[#stack(dir: ttb, spacing: 2.25pt,',
  '[#text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 15.75pt, top-edge: 0.85em, bottom-edge: -0.15em)[', county_name, ' County]],',
  '[#text(fill: rgb("#CFE6EE"), size: 7.9pt)[Opportunity Zone 2.0 — Eligible Census Tracts]])],',
  # Count 26 px + label 8 px; page 15 px + label, 1 px divider, 14 px padding
  '[#grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 12pt, align: horizon,',
  '[#align(right)[#stack(dir: ttb, spacing: 1pt,',
  '[#text(fill: white, size: 19.5pt, weight: "bold", top-edge: 0.85em, bottom-edge: -0.15em)[', n_tracts, ']],',
  '[#text(fill: rgb("', sky, '"), size: 6pt, tracking: 0.75pt)[ELIGIBLE TRACTS]])]],',
  '[#context [#if counter(page).final().first() > 1 [',
  '#block(stroke: (left: 0.75pt + rgb("', teal_soft, '")), inset: (left: 10.5pt, y: 2pt))',
  '[#stack(dir: ttb, spacing: 1.5pt,',
  '[#text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 11.25pt, top-edge: 0.85em, bottom-edge: -0.15em)[#counter(page).display()]',
  '#text(fill: rgb("', sky, '"), weight: "medium", size: 11.25pt, top-edge: 0.85em, bottom-edge: -0.15em)[ \\/ #counter(page).final().first()]],',
  '[#text(fill: rgb("', sky, '"), size: 6pt, tracking: 0.75pt)[PAGE]])]]]])])]'
)

# Legend: 8 px amber label, 10 px swatches (radius 3 px), 8.5 px labels, 18 px gaps
legend_item <- function(hex, label) {
  paste0('#box(baseline: 1pt)[#rect(width: 7.5pt, height: 7.5pt, radius: 2.25pt, fill: rgb("', hex, '"))]',
         '#h(3.75pt)', label, '#h(13.5pt)')
}
legend_block <- paste0(
  '#block(width: 100%, above: 0pt, below: 0pt, inset: (x: 1.5pt, top: 6pt, bottom: 6.75pt))[',
  '#set text(size: 6.4pt, fill: rgb("', body_c, '"));',
  '#text(fill: rgb("', amber, '"), weight: "bold", size: 6pt, tracking: 0.4pt)[INVESTMENT LIKELIHOOD]#h(13.5pt)',
  legend_item("#15705A", "Likely"),
  legend_item("#2F8FB0", "More Likely"),
  legend_item("#D98A3D", "Less Likely"),
  legend_item("#B4532E", "Unlikely"),
  '#h(1fr)#text(fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"), style: "italic")',
  '[Bars show value relative to column maximum · per-tract maps on detail sheets]]'
)

# ── Running footer: "continued" (8 px italic) + sources/glossary (7.5 px) ────
footer_content <- paste0(
  '#block(height: 100%, width: 100%)[',
  '#context [#if counter(page).get().first() < counter(page).final().first() [',
  '#align(right)[#text(fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"), size: 6pt, style: "italic")',
  '[continued on page #(counter(page).get().first() + 1) #text(font: ', mono, ', style: "normal", size: 7.5pt)[→]]]]]',
  '#v(1fr)',
  '#grid(columns: (auto, 1fr, auto), align: bottom,',
  '[#text(fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"), size: 5.6pt)[Sources: Federal OZ 2.0 eligibility · Urban Institute OZ Tool · ',
  'WFRC / MAG regional data. Growth projections 2027–2037.]], [],',
  '[#text(font: ', mono, ', fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"), size: 5.6pt)',
  '[MUorC = Metro/Urban/City center · ATO = Access to Opportunities · ERU = Equiv. Residential Unit · SAP = Station Area Plan]])',
  '#v(15pt)]'
)

# Page padding 26 / 38 / 20 px. The header sits at the bottom of the top margin,
# so the top margin = 26 px + header band + legend strip.
cat("``` {=typst}\n")
cat(paste0(
  '#set page(\n',
  '  flipped: true,\n',
  '  numbering: none,\n',
  '  margin: (x: 0.396in, top: 1.215in, bottom: 0.69in),\n',
  '  header-ascent: 0pt,\n',
  '  footer-descent: 2pt,\n',
  '  header: [', hdr_block, legend_block, '],\n',
  '  footer: [', footer_content, '],\n',
  ')\n'
))
cat("```\n\n")

# ── Two-tier table inside a bordered card ─────────────────────────────────────
# Super header: 8 px bold caps, padding 3/8 px. Column header: 8.5 px bold,
# padding 5/8 px, 2 px teal rule beneath.
grp_hdr <- function(label, colspan = 1, fill = "#FFFFFF", clr = muted_c, align = "left") {
  paste0('table.cell(colspan: ', colspan, ', fill: rgb("', fill, '"), align: ', align, ' + horizon, ',
         'inset: (x: 6pt, y: 3pt))',
         '[#text(fill: rgb("', clr, '"), weight: "bold", size: 6pt, tracking: 0.75pt)[', toupper(label), ']]')
}
col_hdr <- function(label, key = FALSE) {
  fill <- if (key) key_tint else teal
  fg   <- if (key) teal else "#FFFFFF"
  paste0('table.cell(fill: rgb("', fill, '"), inset: (x: 6pt, y: 3pt))',
         '[#text(fill: rgb("', fg, '"), weight: "bold", size: 6.4pt)[', label, ']]')
}

rows <- character(0)
for (i in seq_len(n_tracts)) {
  tract <- county_data[i, ]
  geoid <- as.character(tract$GEOID)
  g  <- function(col) col_val(tract, col)
  fv <- function(col, d = 1, s = "", m = "") fmt_val(g(col), d, s, m)

  oz_cls <- if (is.na(g("oztoolclassification"))) NA_character_ else as.character(g("oztoolclassification"))
  pill <- if (is.na(oz_cls)) {
    paste0('#text(fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"))[—]')
  } else {
    paste0('#box(fill: rgb("', oz_color(oz_cls), '"), radius: 2.25pt, inset: (x: 5.25pt, y: 2.6pt))',
           '[#text(fill: white, size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[', oz_class_short(oz_cls), ']]')
  }

  cells <- c(
    paste0('#text(fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"), size: 6.75pt, weight: "semibold")[', sprintf("%02d", i), ']'),
    paste0('#stack(dir: ttb, spacing: 1pt, oneline("', typst_str(as.character(tract$TractName)), '"),',
           ' text(font: ', mono, ', fill: rgb("', muted_c, '"), size: 6pt)[',
           substr(geoid, 1, 5), ' · ', substr(geoid, 6, 11), '])'),
    paste0('#pair("', fv("pop", 0, m = ","), '", "pop", "', fv("hh", 0, m = ","), '", "hh")'),
    paste0('#pair("', fv("total_acres", 0, m = ","), '", "ac", "', fv("dev_acres", 0, m = ","), '", "dev")'),
    kcell(fv("oz1_pct", 1), rel_pct(g("oz1_pct"), col_max$oz1_pct), teal_soft, unit = "%", full = TRUE),
    kcell(fv("wc_muc_pct", 1), rel_pct(g("wc_muc_pct"), col_max$muc), teal, unit = "%"),
    kcell(fv("ato_composite", 1), rel_pct(g("ato_composite"), col_max$ato), teal_mid),
    kcell(fv("sap_planned_hh_per_acre", 1), rel_pct(g("sap_planned_hh_per_acre"), col_max$sap), teal_soft),
    kcell(fv("eru_per_acre", 1), rel_pct(g("eru_per_acre"), col_max$eru), amber),
    pill
  )
  rows <- c(rows, paste0('  [', cells, '],', collapse = "\n"))
}

# Columns follow the design (26 / 82 / 82 / 64 / 108 px) except, by request, the
# four key columns are 1.0 in each and the Tract column takes the freed width
# (2.437 in; oneline() measures names against the same width).
# Rows are a fixed 32 px (24 pt); stripes on even rows; key cells always tinted.
table_open <- paste0(
  '#block(width: 100%, stroke: 0.75pt + rgb("', line_cool, '"), radius: 3.75pt, clip: true, breakable: true)[\n',
  '#table(\n',
  '  columns: (0.271in, 2.437in, 0.854in, 0.854in, 0.667in, 1in, 1in, 1in, 1in, 1.125in),\n',
  '  rows: (24pt, auto) + (24pt,) * ', n_tracts, ',\n',
  '  inset: (x: 6pt, y: 0pt),\n',
  '  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 1 { (bottom: 1.5pt + rgb("', teal, '")) } ',
  'else if y >= 2 { (bottom: 0.75pt + rgb("', hair, '")) },\n',
  '  fill: (x, y) => if y >= 2 {\n',
  '    if x >= 5 and x <= 8 { rgb("', key_tint, '") }\n',
  '    else if calc.odd(y) { rgb("', row_stripe, '") } else { white }\n',
  '  },\n',
  '  align: (x, y) => if x == 0 and y >= 1 { center + horizon } else { left + horizon },\n'
)
table_header <- paste0(
  '  table.header(\n',
  '    ', grp_hdr(""), ',\n',
  '    ', grp_hdr("Identity"), ',\n',
  '    ', grp_hdr("Profile", 3), ',\n',
  '    ', grp_hdr("Four Key Measures", 4, fill = key_tint, clr = amber, align = "center"), ',\n',
  '    ', grp_hdr(""), ',\n',
  '    ', col_hdr("\\#"), ', ', col_hdr("Tract"), ', ', col_hdr("Pop · HH"), ', ',
  col_hdr("Acres · Dev"), ', ', col_hdr("OZ 1.0 %"), ',\n',
  '    ', col_hdr("MUorC center %", TRUE), ', ', col_hdr("ATO score /100", TRUE), ', ',
  col_hdr("SAP HH / ac", TRUE), ', ', col_hdr("Growth ERU / ac", TRUE), ', ', col_hdr("Likelihood"), ',\n',
  '  ),\n'
)

cat("``` {=typst}\n")
cat(table_open, table_header, paste(rows, collapse = "\n"), "\n)\n]\n", sep = "")
cat("```\n")
```
